title: The card game you can play
summary: Cards in TCG Card Shop Simulator are not only stock: the game defines playable card sets, their own interface and a display for how much damage a card does.
body: There is a card game inside the shop: the game defines a set of cards you can play with their own interface, which is why cards have a life beyond being priced.
Cards carry damage information for play, so a card's worth to a player is a separate matter from what you sell it for.
Drawing cards is queued by the game, which is how a hand fills in order rather than all at once.
The card game has a name and a logo of its own. The build ships title art for it, so the game played inside the shop is presented as its own thing rather than as one more screen of the shop.
What this entry does not tell you: the rules, deck sizes or how playing affects customers. We have not verified those numbers, so we do not print them.

facts.claim: Playable card sets are defined by the game.
A card shows how much damage it does in play.
Drawing cards is handled as a queue.
The build ships a logo of its own for the card game.
The game ships playmats and deck boxes as its own artwork, with a material for the deck box.
The card game has stat icons of its own, including one for a critical and one for a boss.
Element icons are shipped as well, a fire one and an ice one among them.
